gameName: Dead of Winter: A Crossroads Game
firstPlayerRule: The player whose group leader has the highest influence value takes the first player token and takes the first turn.
clarifications: Group leaders are chosen during setup: each player is dealt 4 survivors, keeps 2, and makes one of them their group leader.
Player turns go clockwise (to the left), starting with the first player.
At the end of each round, the first player passes the first player token to the player on their right.
The first player also breaks all ties during the game.
